objective: Loss Function & Regularization Ablation: Isolate reconstruction loss, weight decay, and latent manifold constraints

baseline_l1.name: Baseline: L1 Loss + Weight Decay 1e-4
baseline_l1.description: Current verified baseline reconstruction objective with moderate L2 weight decay

loss_smooth_l1.name: Alternative Loss: Smooth L1 / Huber Loss (beta=0.1)
loss_smooth_l1.description: Robust Huber loss: quadratic below beta=0.1 for smooth gradients, linear above beta to cap outlier gradients

reg_low_weight_decay.name: Regularization Ablation: Low Weight Decay (1e-5)
reg_low_weight_decay.description: 10x lower weight decay to test if baseline weight decay is over-regularizing network parameters

reg_high_weight_decay.name: Regularization Ablation: High Weight Decay (1e-3)
reg_high_weight_decay.description: 10x higher weight decay to test if stronger parameter shrinkage prevents overfitting

reg_latent_penalty.name: Manifold Regularization: Bottleneck Latent L2 Penalty (1e-4)
reg_latent_penalty.description: Explicit L2 penalty on latent bottleneck activations (lambda_latent * ||z||_2^2) to constrain normal manifold volume
